about: Fast Guy Explaining is a short GIF of a bearded man in a black blazer and T-shirt standing in a bright, pillared hallway, talking at high speed and gesturing with both hands as if summarizing something enormous in record time. Letterbox bars frame the shot. It stands for the over-eager explanation: talking far too fast, too long or too passionately about something nobody asked about.
usage:
Top box: who is explaining and what. Bottom box: the detail that shows it is too much, too fast, or totally unwanted.

It fits plot summaries, game lore, crypto pitches, fantasy football rules and anyone explaining a meme to their parents. The bigger the topic and the shorter the time, the better.
ideas: me explaining the plot of a 3 hour movie
to someone who asked one question
me explaining why I was late
the dev explaining why it works on their machine
